snippet.title: Burial Ground, Dev Playthrough (Updated/100%/All notes, maps, dogtags, etc)
snippet.description:
A full playthrough of Burial Ground, my custom story for Amnesia: The Bunker, for those who are stuck, want to know what they missed, and/or simply can't be bothered to play it. This time, updated to include the past 2 major patches worth of changes.
